dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 60-degree incline relative to the longitudinal dorsal axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 150 degrees at the melon-rostrum transition point.
